blocks.heading: Readymade Collar & Cuff
blocks.intro: Purpose-built fusible interlining, calibrated specifically for collar roll and cuff edge sharpness that holds through repeated ironing and washing.

blocks.imageAlt: Collar and cuff interlining fabric prepared for shirt manufacturing
blocks.heading: A Step Up In Precision From General-Purpose Fusible
blocks.html:
Standard fusible interlining works across a wide range of garment parts. Readymade collar & cuff is a different job — it is cut and calibrated specifically for the fold, roll and edge of a shirt collar and cuff, where any inconsistency shows up immediately on a finished garment.

We produce this category with tighter control over stiffness and edge behaviour than our general-purpose fusible line, because a collar has to do something a flat panel doesn't: roll cleanly at the fold, hold that roll after fusing, and keep a sharp edge through the iron, the wash and the wear.
checklist: Calibrated specifically for collar roll and cuff edge structure
Supplied readymade as die-cut, ready-to-fuse panels — or as roll form for your own cutting room
Consistent fuse quality across the full production run

blocks.heading: Readymade Collar & Cuff FAQs
blocks.intro: Have a question specific to your shirt style or fabric? Ask us directly and we'll respond within one business day.

items.q: Do you supply pre-cut collar and cuff panels or only roll form?
items.a: Both. We supply die-cut, ready-to-fuse collar and cuff panels for buyers who want to save cutting-room time, and standard roll form for units that cut in-house. Let us know your preference when you enquire.

items.q: Can stiffness be adjusted for a softer collar roll?
items.a: Yes. We produce this category across soft, medium and firm roll grades. Share your shirt style — formal, casual or button-down — and we'll recommend the grade that fits, or arrange a sample for evaluation.

items.q: What is the minimum order quantity for pre-cut panels?
items.a: Minimum quantities for pre-cut panels depend on the collar/cuff pattern and sizing you need. Share your specification through our contact form and we'll confirm feasible order sizes and lead time.

items.q: Can I get a sample matched to my shirt fabric?
items.a: Yes. Send us a swatch of your shirting fabric along with your collar style and we'll arrange a matched sample for fuse and roll testing before you commit to a bulk order.
